sources.title: Recurrent pregnancy loss: a committee opinion (2026)
sources.claim: RPL = 2 or more losses; chromosome analysis of miscarriage tissue first; parental karyotype offered when needed; cavity evaluation for all unexplained RPL; aPL testing if criteria met; TSH; routine thrombophilia, immune and ovarian reserve testing not recommended; vaginal progesterone may be offered with bleeding and/or unexplained recurrent loss; aspirin + heparin for APS; empiric anticoagulants not for unexplained RPL; 50-80% succeed with no specific intervention; 50-60% of first-trimester miscarriages are aneuploid; PGT-A not shown to reduce miscarriage in RPL; association between chronic endometritis and RPL; psychological support essential
sources.quote: Approximately 50%–60% of first-trimester miscarriages are due to embryonic aneuploidy; 50%–80% of patients will succeed in their subsequent pregnancy attempt with no specific interventions; Routine testing for thrombophilias is not recommended among women with RPL; PGT-A has not been shown to be effective at reducing miscarriage or increasing LBR in the setting of RPL

sources.title: Evaluation and treatment of recurrent pregnancy loss: a committee opinion
sources.claim: Up to 50% of RPL has no clearly defined cause; standard APS treatment is low-dose aspirin plus heparin
sources.quote: Up to 50% of cases of RPL will not have a clearly defined etiology; The standard treatment for documented antiphospholipid syndrome consists of low-dose aspirin and heparin

sources.title: ESHRE guideline: recurrent pregnancy loss: an update in 2022
sources.claim: RPL defined as loss of two or more pregnancies; vaginal progesterone may improve live birth in women with 3+ losses and bleeding; sperm DNA fragmentation could be considered; HLA testing not recommended; prognosis based on age and full pregnancy history
sources.quote: RPL is defined as the loss of two or more pregnancies; Vaginal progesterone may improve live birth rate in women with three or more pregnancy losses; Assessing sperm DNA fragmentation in couples with RPL could be considered for diagnostic purposes

sources.title: Reproductive outcomes following recurrent first-trimester miscarriage: a retrospective cohort study
sources.claim: 748 women with recurrent miscarriage; 60% unexplained; 77% had a further pregnancy, live birth rate 63% in those pregnancies; cumulative live birth 44% at age 40 or over
sources.quote: There were 748 women who were included; 60% had unexplained RM; 77% had a subsequent pregnancy, and among these pregnancies, the livebirth rate was 63%; reduced to 44% in women aged ≥40 years

sources.title: Heparin for women with recurrent miscarriage and inherited thrombophilia (ALIFE2): an international open-label, randomised controlled trial
sources.claim: 326 women with inherited thrombophilia and recurrent loss; live birth 72% with LMWH vs 71% standard care; LMWH not advised; screening for inherited thrombophilia not advised
sources.quote: 116 (72%) of 162 women with primary outcome data in the LMWH group and 112 (71%) of 158 in the standard care group; LMWH did not result in higher livebirth rates

sources.title: Progesterone could increase live births in women with early pregnancy bleeding and a history of miscarriage (PRISM trial, NEJM 2019)
sources.journal: University of Birmingham / New England Journal of Medicine
sources.claim: PRISM: 4,153 women with early bleeding; in women with 3 or more previous miscarriages, live birth 72% with progesterone vs 57% placebo
sources.quote: 4,153 pregnant women who presented with early pregnancy bleeding; 98 of 137 (72%) progesterone vs 85 of 148 (57%) placebo in women with 3+ previous miscarriages

sources.title: A Randomized Trial of Progesterone in Women with Bleeding in Early Pregnancy
sources.claim: Overall live birth 75% progesterone vs 72% placebo among 4,153 women
sources.quote: The incidence of live births after at least 34 weeks of gestation was 75% (1513 of 2025 women) in the progesterone group and 72% (1459 of 2013 women) in the placebo group

sources.title: Double-blind multi-centre randomised placebo-controlled trial of doxycycline in women with recurrent miscarriage and chronic endometritis defined by CD138 positive stromal cells (CERM)
sources.claim: Over 2,000 women screened, 505 CD138 positive, 438 randomised; live birth or ongoing pregnancy 52% doxycycline vs 50% placebo; doxycycline not associated with better live birth
sources.quote: Of 2178 women screened, 505 were positive for CD138 and 438 were randomised; 113/219 (52%) in the doxycycline group and 109/219 (50%) in the placebo group

sources.title: Chronic Endometritis Due to Common Bacteria Is Prevalent in Women With Recurrent Miscarriage as Confirmed by Improved Pregnancy Outcome After Antibiotic Treatment
sources.claim: 360 women with unexplained recurrent miscarriage; 57.8% had chronic endometritis at hysteroscopy; pregnancy within a year 78.4% when cured vs 17.5% when persistent
sources.quote: 208 (57.8%) women with RM showed CE at hysteroscopy; group 1 showed a significantly higher number of pregnancies (78.4%) compared to group 2 (17.5%)

sources.title: Relationship Among Traditional Semen Parameters, Sperm DNA Fragmentation, and Unexplained Recurrent Miscarriage: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
sources.claim: 19 studies, 1,182 couples with unexplained recurrent miscarriage vs 1,231 without; sperm DNA fragmentation significantly higher in the RM couples
sources.quote: 19 publications were eligible; 1182 couples with unexplained RM and 1231 couples without RM; couples with unexplained RM had significantly increased levels of SDF
